title: hive-census receipt (schema v0)
description: A change receipt: evidence lines about one base..head change, each tagged with its epistemic status. Tags are a fixed vocabulary; an undecided producer yields 'unverified' or 'not-run', never a deciding tag.

provenance.description: Engine + composer version stamps and the base/head SHAs the receipt binds to. `ref` (optional) is the measured line's ref name — the checkout's branch resolved at build time, or the builder's explicit --ref override; absent on a detached HEAD or a git fault. `repo` (optional) is the repository identity the builder chose to record (--repo-id), verbatim; absent when unset.

precision.description: Per-class decided-fraction entries; a below-budget class is shown, not gated.

context.description: Optional institutional-memory references recalled from the fleet memory for touched subjects. Trust-labelled REFERENCE only: informs the reader, never an evidence line, never gates. Absent when nothing was recalled.

propagation.description: Optional blast-radius neighbourhoods of breaking/removed seeds (built under --propagate): per seed, the callers/dependents/tests resolved to head-graph path::Symbol spellings. Advisory staleness fuel only — never an evidence line, never gates. Absent when not requested or nothing resolved.

context_entry.description: One fleet-memory reference: labels (trust/polarity/kind) ride verbatim from the recall envelope — carried, never interpreted, no tier filtered.

propagation_entry.description: One breaking/removed seed and its head-resolved blast-radius neighbourhood. Only the two suspicion-justifying drifts are admissible; neighbours are path::Symbol spellings, never engine node ids.
